Positioning: The Key to Market Success

How to define your product’s place in the market so that value is obvious and customers naturally gravitate toward it.

## What Is Positioning? Positioning is not just about choosing a market category — it's about creating a clear context in which your product’s value is immediately obvious to your ideal customers. As April Dunford puts it, "The best market category is the context I position my product in such that this value is kind of obvious to these people." This means you don’t just pick a category — you build a narrative that makes your solution feel natural, necessary, and aligned with what your audience already values. ## How to Build Effective Positioning
  • Start with value, not category. Ask: "What specific problem do I solve, and for whom?" Value must be clear and urgent.
  • Identify your ideal customer profile. Who truly cares about your value?
## Real-World Example: IBM in Africa Timothy Davis of Shopify shares a key insight: there were many currencies, and the product was only available in **USD**.
